input.description:
Input for the standalone multi-clip animation endpoint.

Auto-rigs a humanoid GLB model and generates multiple animation clips
against that single rig — one clip per ID in ``animation_action_ids``.
Unlike the per-generator endpoints (which apply a single optional
animation), this endpoint is dedicat

height_meters.description: Approximate height of the character in meters.

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, input data will be checked for safety before processing.

model_url.description: URL of a 3D model in GLB format to rig and animate. Can be any publicly accessible URL — works with models generated by Hunyuan, Trellis, Meshy, or any other 3D generation tool. The model must be a humanoid character with clearly defined limbs.

animation_action_ids.description: Animation preset IDs from Meshy's library. One animation clip is generated per ID against the same rig and returned in the 'animations' output array, in request order. Must contain at least one ID. Each ID must be in [0, 696], at most 10 distinct clips may be requested, and duplicate IDs are de-dupl
